job: Two drives have failed in the data hall: one high up in row A at U40 and one low down in row B at U10. Pull both sled caddies and bring the last one out to the staging bench outside the hall.

world.source: hand-written scenario, not a scan: a small data hall with two rack rows and a 1.2 m cold aisle

output.understood_as: Pull the failed drive sleds from bay A U40 (high) and bay B U10 (low) in the data hall, and carry the last one pulled out of the hall to the staging bench.
steps: Go to row A and pull the drive sled from bay U40 (high up).
Go to row B and pull the drive sled from bay U10 (low down).
Carry that last sled out of the hall.

tasks.why: Pull the failed sled from the high bay in row A first; the job only asks for the last one to be brought out.
Pull the failed sled from the low bay in row B last and carry it out of the hall, as asked.

demos.why: Shows how the hand releases the sled handle and slides the caddy straight out of its bay without binding.
Sets a grip firm enough that the sled cannot slip out while being pulled and carried, but gentle enough not to bend the handle or jolt the drive.

questions: What should happen to the first sled pulled (row A, U40)? Should the robot leave it in or on the rack, or carry it out too along with the second one?
By 'the last one' did you mean the second sled pulled (I have taken that to be row B, U10, done after row A), or a specific drive?
unmet: Setting the sled down on the staging bench: the planner can only take things to the way out of the hall, not to a particular spot like the bench, so the sled will be carried out but not placed on the bench.
